content.value: Suppose, we want to fit a line $y = m x + b$ through the points (1, 2), (2, 3), (3, 4), (4, 5) (12) [CO3] and (5, 6). Assume, initial values of m and b are 0.1 and 0.2 respectively. Calculate the initial error using mean squared error loss function and then apply a gradient descent step. Use learning rate, $\alpha = 0 . 0 1$ and calculate the error of fit again after the gradient descent step.
